title: Retrieval-augmented generation diagram
alt: Flow diagram in which a user query retrieves documents that are supplied with the query to a language model before it produces a response.
caption: Retrieval can supply relevant material to a model; it does not guarantee that the answer uses or represents that material correctly.
teachingUse: Lets students trace query, retrieval, supplied context, and generated answer while preserving the need for source checking.
